item.title: Conan on desire to keep playing and Farrell's influence
item.description: Jack Conan tells the Ireland Rugby Social podcast of Andy Farrell's influence in implementing a cultural shift in camp, his shoulder injury and desire to keep playing while he feels physically and mentally able. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: West Ham confirm Parker as boss
item.description: West Ham confirm the appointment of former midfielder Scott Parker as their head coach on a two-and-a-half-year deal. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: LIV aimed to 'destroy the European Tour' - McIlroy
item.description: Six-time major winner Rory McIlroy says those connected to LIV Golf were expressing an ambition to "destroy the European Tour" at the 2026 Masters, only months before the league filed for bankruptcy protection. Fuente: BBC Sport.
